retrievalProfile.description: A warm, candid portrait of a musician with an acoustic guitar, featuring bold slab-serif display type and a secondary modern sans-serif subtitle.
triggerTerms: warm rustic portrait with bold slab serif
excludeWhen: minimalist black and white photography is requested
electronic or futuristic music themes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a smiling man in a denim jacket leaning his arms over the body of an acoustic guitar, set against a warm indoor background with a green wall accent. The composition uses a right-aligned typographic block with high-contrast slab-serif lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed away from the camera toward the light source
Guitar body acting as a foreground anchor and diagonal lead-in
Text block positioned in the upper right quadrant to balance the subject's weight on the left
coreInvariants: Warm, naturalistic lighting with soft highlights on the face
Denim and wood textures providing a rustic feel
Two-tier typographic hierarchy with distinct font styles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, medium-close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange-yellow body of the acoustic guitar in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the guitar, moves up the subject's arms to the face, then follows the gaze to the text block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The green wall on the right provides a flat surface for text legibility.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm wood tones and denim blue (subject and guitar)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the guitar body; medium-low saturation in the background to emphasize the subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and wide geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, blocky serifs with uniform stroke weight
Secondary text is extended, wide-tracked, and features a horizontal glow effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard glyph forms used for maximum legibility
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between a heavy, traditional slab serif and a modern, wide-tracked sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal orange light streaks behind the subtitle

preserve: Slab serif style for the main name
avoid: Centering the text over the subject's face

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, low-contrast slab serif structure
Matches the wide, geometric feel of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm-toned photograph of a man with a beard and denim jacket, smiling and leaning his arms over the top of an acoustic guitar. The background should feature a doorway and a sage green wall on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a large, stacked tan slab-serif font in the upper right. Below it, add the album title in a small, wide-tracked white sans-serif font with a subtle orange horizontal glow effect.

verificationChecks: Is the guitar the primary foreground element?
Is the text legible against the green wall?
Does the subject's gaze lead toward the text?
Are the slab serifs thick and blocky?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any brand logos on the guitar headstock

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the subject's face
Ensure the guitar strings are rendered clearly
Verify the orange glow effect is horizontal and subtle
Confirm the slab serif font has a heavy visual weight
recipe.reuseFormula: Candid musician portrait + acoustic guitar foreground + right-aligned slab serif typography = Country Album Aesthetic
